summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting changes in board and fiscal council nominees ahead of an Extraordinary General Meeting. Petrobras and FIP proposed adjustments to bylaw amendments following a shareholders' agreement amendment. Director nominee Olavo Bentes David was replaced by Marcelo Weick Pogliese; fiscal council nominee Ivan Apsan Frediani was replaced by Felipe Rath Fingerl, with Audrey Cruz e Silva Saad as alternate. The changes appear coordinated among major shareholders, not abrupt departures. No deal terms, prices, or adviser names disclosed. Watch for EGM outcomes and shareholder alignment.
